patthana17.26:1.1: pītisahagataṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na pītisahagato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: satta.
patthana17.26:2.1: sukhasahagataṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sukhasahagato na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: satta.
patthana17.26:4.1: vedanāttikasadisaṃ. saṅkhittaṃ. sanidassanattika kusalattike nasanidassanattika nakusalattikaṃ
